verdict.rationale:
Docs confirm a dedicated 'Unreal Automation Tool' for automating testing and building (unreal-docs-30) and command-line arguments explicitly for testing/optimizing projects, including forcing game mode instead of full-editor mode (unreal-docs-7, unreal-docs-32), which supports headless-style runs against the real engine. However, there is no documentation here of the actual unit/integration test authoring frameworks (e.g., Automation Spec, functional tests) or concrete CI pipeline examples, and no independent/hands-on corroboration that headless test runs work reliably in CI.

missing for 10: explicit test-framework docs (Automation Spec/functional tests), concrete CI headless invocation examples, independent corroboration of CI test runs against the real engine.
